import ../bend2039-upgrade/bend2/selfhost/ast.bend as AST
import ../bend2039-upgrade/bend2/selfhost/backend_ir.bend as BIR
import ../bend2039-upgrade/bend2/selfhost/target_io.bend as TargetIO

def absent() -> String:
  "/tmp/bend2039-target-io.41AB7g/absent.c"

def fifo() -> String:
  "/tmp/bend2039-target-io.41AB7g/unopened.fifo"

def planned(path: String) -> TargetIO.PlannedFile:
  TargetIO.PlannedFile{path, AST.SpanOf{"declared-source.bend", 7n, 11n}}

def report(loaded: TargetIO.LoadResult) -> IO(U32):
  match loaded:
    case TargetIO.LoadFailure{message, span}:
      do IO<U32>:
        Unit <- IO.print(String.append("FAILFAST ", message))
        return 0
    case TargetIO.LoadSuccess{_}: IO.pure(U32, 1)

def main() -> IO(U32):
  do IO<U32>:
    loaded : TargetIO.LoadResult <- TargetIO.read_files([planned(absent()), planned(fifo())], Nil{})
    report(loaded)
